Poison is a Damage Over Time Status inflicted as an On Hit Effect or from some Skills.

## Contents

- 1 Description

- 2 Known Modifiers

- 2.1 Character Stats

- 3 Affixes

## Description[]

Poison deals Poison Damage over 3 seconds. An enemy can have multiple instances of poison at once. Each stack decreases enemy poison resistance by 5% (2% for bosses and players).

The base poison damage is 20 (over 3 seconds). This damage is further modified by Increased Damage, Increased Poison Damage and Increased Damage over Time.
